'''Gradak Ungan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Great Galactic War]], becoming an elite commando with best assignments. However, he was dissatisfied with the pay and eventually left, joining the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. He was made a captain of [[Reneget Vause]] after pushing both Republic and the Empire out of the White Maw Territory on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and was put in charge of the underground smelting operations. Ungan was especially cruel to slaves, often leading them without heat-resisting shields. In [[3642 BBY]] he was confronted and killed by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], who sought to draw Vause out of hiding.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gradak Ungan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Hoth. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
